Example Node

GN-510 Spatial Organization

Definition: How spatial relationships communicate organization.

Children: - GN-511 Proximity - GN-512 Separation - GN-513 Density - GN-514 Alignment - GN-515 Enclosure - GN-516 Connectedness

Measured Variables: - center-to-center distance - edge-to-edge distance - spacing ratio - eccentricity

Related Laws: - LAW-001 - LAW-013

Relationship Graph

Perception → Attention → Grouping → Hierarchy → Navigation → Decision Making
